behavior.arguments: rdi = out pointer (2 words), rsi = in pointer (first word only), rdx = 64-bit scalar

edges.high_product_discarded: imul r/m64 keeps only the low 64 bits of scalar * in0; the high word never exists in any register
edges.input_second_word_never_read: no instruction reads in + 0x8; only (rsi) is loaded
edges.out_second_word_overwritten_not_read: entry out[1] is never loaded; the store to out + 0x8 unconditionally writes the scalar

behavior.return_shape: no return value is set; rax holds the saved scalar at ret but no return meaning is claimed
behavior.stored_rule: out[0] -= scalar * in[0] (mod 2^64, low product only); out[1] = scalar

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

naming_relocation.note: no relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend; absence of a naming relocation does not identify provenance
